sourceNotes.rawContent: Elevate your everyday look with these gold-toned stainless-steel hoops featuring a unique, textured bamboo-inspired design. These fashionable earrings add a bold, modern edge to any outfit. To preserve their brilliant golden luster, keep them away from moisture and perfumes, and store them safely in a dry place after use.
